title: Federated and Balanced $k$-means: Communication Efficiency, Privacy, and Heterogeneity
abstract: arXiv:2611.27114v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Collaborating on data across organizations in healthcare and finance demands methods that preserve privacy while enabling effective analysis. Vertical Federated Learning (VFL) facilitates clustering across data where different parties hold different features of the same entities without sharing raw data. However, existing VFL clustering methods suffer from two key limitations: vulnerability to information leakage and the creation of imbalanced clusters. To address these limitations, we propose Fabric, a balanced and privacy-preserving federated $k$-means algorithm. Our method decomposes the balanced clustering problem into independent subproblems for each client, using the Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM) to efficiently handle the balance constraints. translated_title: 联邦平衡k均值算法：通信效率、隐私与异构性
translated_abstract: 在医疗和金融领域进行跨组织的数据协作，需要既能保护隐私又能支持有效分析的方法。垂直联邦学习使得各方无需共享原始数据，即可对同一实体的不同特征数据进行聚类。然而，现有的垂直联邦聚类方法存在两个关键局限：容易发生信息泄露，以及会产生不平衡的聚类。为解决这些局限，我们提出了Fabric，一种平衡且保护隐私的联邦k均值算法。我们的方法将平衡聚类问题分解为每个客户端的独立子问题，并利用交替方向乘子法（ADMM）高效处理平衡约束。在半诚实模型下，Fabric通过在局部目标评估中注入经过校准的噪声，提供了可证明的隐私保证。在十个真实数据集上的广泛评估……
tldr: 本文提出Fabric，一种平衡且保护隐私的联邦k均值算法，通过ADMM将平衡聚类分解为各客户端独立子问题，并借助校准噪声注入实现可证明的隐私保证，解决了现有垂直联邦聚类方法信息泄露和聚类不平衡的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Fabric, a balanced and privacy-preserving federated k-means algorithm that decomposes the balanced clustering problem into independent per-client subproblems via ADMM and achieves provable privacy guarantees through calibrated noise injection, addressing information leakage and cluster imbalance in vertical federated learning.
